announcements.text: Air Space Intelligence Federal Inc.,* Cambridge, Massachusetts, has been awarded a $26,020,100 firm-fixed-price purchase order for the procurement of Flyways Artificial Intelligence commercial software licenses. This purchase order provides for the commercial software license for the use and customization of the cloud-hosted Flyways Artificial Intelligence Platform by the 618th Air Operations Center. Work will be performed at Scott Air Force Base, Illinois, and is expected to be completed by Sept. 28, 2031. This contract was a sole-source acquisition. Fiscal 2026 Transportation Working Capital Funds in the amount of $5,000,000 are being obligated at the time of award. The 763d Enterprise Sourcing Squadron, Scott AFB, Illinois, is the contracting activity (FA4452-26-P-0019). (Awarded on Sept. 28, 2026).

announcements.text: General Dynamics – Applied Physical Sciences (APS) Corp., Groton, Connecticut, is awarded a $19,999,957 cost-plus-fixed-fee completion type contract for the effort titled “Advancements in Undersea Dominance and Naval Engineering.” This contract is for conducting studies and developing new technologies aligned with this new framework for naval warfare. In all cases first principles and physics-based modeling and simulation will be emphasized. While in-house research will be performed, and in-house capability exploited when relevant, APS shall leverage, where appropriate, available domestic and foreign technologies in novel technique development to assure state-of-the-art capabilities. Work will be performed in Groton, Connecticut, and is expected to be completed in September 2031. The total cumulative value of this contract, including a 60-month base period with no options, is $19,999,957. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test and evaluation (Navy) funds in the amount of $5,100,000 are obligated at the time of award and will not expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract was competitively procured under long range broad agency announcement (N0001425SB001) entitled "Long Range Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) for Navy and Marine Corps Science and Technology." Since proposals will be received throughout the year under the Long-Range BAA, the number of proposals received in response to the solicitation is unknown. The Office of Naval Research, Arlington, Virginia, is the contracting activity (N0001426C1321).

announcements.text: Vigor Marine LLC, Portland, Oregon, is awarded a $13,789,573 firm-fixed-price contract (N3220527C0001) for a 50-calendar day shipyard availability for the mid-term availability of Military Sealift Command’s fleet ordnance and dry cargo vessel USNS Alan Shepard (T-AKE 3). This contract includes a base work package and three unexercised options for additional work and time which, if exercised, would increase the cumulative value of this contract to $14,147,535. Work will be performed in Portland, Oregon, beginning Dec. 1, 2026, and is expected to be completed by Jan. 19, 2027. Fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance (Navy) funds in the amount of $13,789,573 are obligated and will expire at the end of the fiscal year. This contract was competitively procured with proposals solicited via the Government wide Point of Entry website and two offers were received. Military Sealift Command, Norfolk, Virginia, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Dayton T. Brown Inc., Bohemia, New York, is awarded a $10,000,000 cost modification (P00017) to an order (N0042124F0512) under a previously awarded basic ordering agreement (N0042123G0005). This modification increases the ceiling within the existing scope to provide mobile mission systems hardware, software, and integration materials supporting cybersecurity requirements, network upgrades, system modifications, and capability improvements to construct three triton hubs. Work will be performed in Hollywood, Maryland, and is expected to be completed in June 2027. Fiscal 2027 research, development, test and evaluation (Navy) funds in the amount of $9,591,731 will be obligated at the time of award. This contract modification was not competitively procured. Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.
